program.name: Standing Pilates
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Pilates on your feet: roll-downs, leg lifts, pliés and heel raises, with a short mat finish.
program.about: Pilates mostly on your feet, for balance, posture and legs. Roll-downs, front and side leg lifts, plié squats and heel raises make up the standing part, and a short mat series finishes each day. Two versions alternate between leg work and balance. Levels II and III add reps. Good when getting down on the floor for long is not appealing.
